description:
Turn your Mac into a powerful security system. Lock-Watcher silently monitors your computer and captures a photo or a short video whenever suspicious activity is detected.

HOW IT WORKS
Lock-Watcher runs quietly in your menu bar, watching for events that may indicate unauthorized access. When triggered, it instantly takes a photo or records a silent 1–5 second video using your built-in or external camera, and enriches it with location, IP address, and network trace-route data.

SECURITY TRIGGERS
- Wake-Up Detection — captures when your Mac exits sleep mode
- Login Monitoring — captures on user login events
- Power Switch — captures when switching from AC to battery (laptops)
- USB Mount — captures when a physical external drive is connected; disk images, network shares, and internal volumes are ignored
- Wrong Password — captures on failed login attempts*

NEW: TRIGGERS WHILE YOUR MAC IS LOCKED
- Display Attached — captures when a display is connected while the Mac is locked
- Location Change — captures when the Mac has moved 500 m or more since you last unlocked it
- Keyboard or Mouse Input — captures when someone touches the keyboard or mouse on the lock screen, after a delay you set from 0 to 10 seconds; a repeated attempt in the same lock is captured again 30 seconds later
- All three are off by default and fire only while the Mac is locked

PHOTO OR VIDEO
- Choose a photo or a silent 1–5 second video for each detection
- Choose the output size: Original, 1/2, or 1/4
- Adjustable photo quality to save cloud storage
- No microphone access — videos never record sound

RICH SNAPSHOT DATA
Every capture can include:
- GPS location coordinates
- Network IP address
- Network trace-route analysis
- Precise timestamp

FLEXIBLE STORAGE
Choose where your photos and videos are saved:
- Local encrypted database on your Mac
- iCloud Drive for seamless sync across devices
- Dropbox for cloud backup
- System notifications with snapshot preview
- "Keep files" removes old local captures after 1 year, 1 month, 1 week, or right after upload

PRIVACY & SECURITY
- All data stored locally or in your own cloud accounts
- Encrypted local database
- No third-party analytics or tracking
- Biometric authentication (Touch ID and Apple Watch)
- Password protection for snapshots and settings
- A notification tells you when camera access is denied

EASY SETUP
- Simple menu bar interface
- Configure triggers with a single toggle
- Choose your preferred storage options
- Set it and forget it — Lock-Watcher works silently in the background

Lock-Watcher is designed for anyone who wants to know who's accessing their Mac — whether at home, in the office, or on the go.

*Some features vary by distribution method.
promotionalText: New triggers fire while your Mac is locked: a display attached, a location change, or any keyboard or mouse input. Photo or video, saved to your own iCloud or Dropbox.
whatsNew:
Lock-Watcher v1.7.0 adds triggers that fire only while your Mac is locked:

- Display attached while locked
- Location change while locked: the Mac moved 500 m or more since you last unlocked it
- Keyboard or mouse input while locked, after a delay you set from 0 to 10 seconds; a repeated attempt is captured again 30 seconds after a capture
- The new triggers are off by default
- The USB trigger now ignores disk images, network shares, and internal volumes; physical external drives still trigger
- Your saved settings carry over
- Ukrainian localization completed and corrected
